name: home-depot/search
description: Search Home Depot products by keyword with price, brand, model number, rating, delivery and pickup availability, filters and pagination.

q.description: The search query. You can use anything that you would use in a regular The Home Depot search.

ps.description: Determines the number of items per page. There are scenarios where The Home Depot overrides the `ps` value. By default, The Home Depot returns `24` (maximum allowed value) results.

nao.description: Defines offset for products result. A single page contains 24 products. First page offset is 0, second -> 24, third -> 48 and so on.

page.description: Value is used to get the items on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). This parameter is common for both US and CA searches.

sort.description: Results sorted by different options in Home Depot Canada. It can be set to: `price-asc`: Price Low to High, `price-desc`: Price High to Low, `reviewAvgRating`: Top Rated, `relevance`: Recommended (Default)

store.description: Store ID to filter the products by the specific store only in Home Depot Canada. The default store is Gatineau (`7140`). See all Home Depot Canada stores

filter.description: Used to pass filter tokens divided by dash (-) in Home Depot Canada. Filter tokens can be obtained from API response

minmax.description: Defines lower and upper bound for price in CAD. Parameter is only used in the Home Depot Canada. Example: `price:[100 TO 500]`(Between $100 to $500) Example: `price:[100 TO *]`(Minimum $100) Example: `price:[0 TO 500]`(Maximum $500) Example: `price:%5B100%20TO%20500%5D`(Encoded version, Between $100 to $500)

country.description: The country to use for the Home Depot search. Only United States(`us`), and Canada(`ca`) are supported.

hd_sort.description: Results sorted by different options in Home Depot US. It can be set to: `top_sellers`: Top Sellers, `price_low_to_high`: Price Low to High, `price_high_to_low`: Price High to Low, `top_rated`: Top Rated, `best_match`: Best Match

pagesize.description: Determines the number of items per page in the Home Depot Canada. By default, the Home Depot Canada returns `40` (maximum allowed value) results.

store_id.description: Store ID to filter the products by the specific store only. See all Home Depot stores

lowerbound.description: Defines lower bound for price in USD.

upperbound.description: Defines upper bound for price in USD.

delivery_zip.description: ZIP Postal code. To filter the shipping products by a selected area.

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

hd_filter_tokens.description: Used to pass filter tokens divided by comma. Filter tokens can be obtained from API response

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

# Home Depot Search

Search Home Depot products by keyword with price, brand, model number, rating, delivery and pickup availability, filters and pagination.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/home-depot/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q": "cordless drill"}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.
